rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold. I'm not able to give you an on-the-record quote by tomorrow's deadline — I'm working through a disclosure step on my end before I attach my name to anything public, and I don't want to rush past that. If you're doing a follow-up piece down the line, I'd be glad to talk then. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Declined the reporter's quote request (deadline was tomorrow noon) — invited a follow-up later.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Idris Bellamy <grants@emberfallfund.org> with subject "Re: Rapid grants — yes, you can still apply". It read: "Hi Idris, Good to meet you too. rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — that genuinely helps. Here's a concrete, no-rush ask that fits five hours a week: A landscape/gap scan of the independent AI-safety ecosystem — existing grants, evals efforts, reading groups, newsletters, etc. — mapped against what's actually neglected. The goal is to make sure anything Halcyon Threshold does is additive, not duplicative. A simple spreadsheet (source, what they do, apparent gap) would be perfect. A couple of weeks is totally fine. I'm sorting out a procedural thing on my end before I can say more publicly about shape/plans, but this piece is useful regardless of how that resolves. Thank you again for offering. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman with a concrete, low-risk ask: a landscape/gap-map of the independent AI-safety ecosystem
